title: Add context-first pull request review
summary: Repository pages now surface open GitHub pull requests, recent review banners, exact-head Snapshot links, and a dedicated evidence-first PR review page that explains product impact before code inspection. Readiness signals distinguish verified success, actionable blockers, and evidence that has not yet been evaluated.
userVisibleChange: Reviewers can open a repository's Pull requests tab, see PR readiness and linked Snapshot context, and review product impact, acceptance criteria, verification, artifacts, risks, decisions, and curated code from a dedicated PR page. Missing evidence is shown as unevaluated rather than as a contradictory success or duplicate Snapshot blocker.

risks.title: Large repositories currently show the latest 50 pull requests
risks.mitigation: The UI discloses the available count, links to GitHub for the full list, and keeps direct PR routes available.

risks.title: GitHub metadata may be temporarily unavailable
risks.mitigation: Repository pages degrade gracefully and explain the unavailable connection instead of blocking Snapshot history.

timeline.title: Locked the PR review product plan
timeline.summary: Defined repository navigation, recent PR context, exact-head linkage, and evidence-first review acceptance criteria.

timeline.title: Built repository and PR review surfaces
timeline.summary: Added GitHub-backed PR APIs, repository tab/count/banner context, Snapshot association, breadcrumbs, readiness signals, and evidence/code review tabs.

timeline.title: Verified application and package behavior
timeline.summary: Ran Go, UI, TypeScript/build, npm package, and package dry-run verification.

timeline.title: Reviewed standards and signal semantics
timeline.summary: Resolved spec and standards findings, including contradictory check copy, duplicate Snapshot blockers, and false-positive scope success.

decisions.title: Keep product evidence as the default PR review surface
decisions.rationale: EVE reviews context, intent, verification, decisions, and user-visible impact before exposing curated code inspection.

decisions.title: Associate PRs only with an unambiguous exact-head Snapshot
decisions.rationale: Branch and head SHA must identify one Snapshot so stale product evidence cannot appear current.

decisions.title: Reuse GitHub CLI authentication and authority
decisions.rationale: The existing local GitHub session remains the source for PR metadata without adding another credential path.

decisions.title: Treat unavailable evidence as unknown
decisions.rationale: Scope, Plan, and EVE checks render neutrally until exact-head evidence exists; warning and success icons are reserved for states EVE can actually substantiate.

validation.output: All Go packages passed, including cmd/eve integration coverage.
TypeScript validation and production Vite build passed; embedded UI assets refreshed.
